name: G4 agent proposal review
description: Slice S9 (ADR-0051): an agent proposal reviewed and applied in the real window. SETUP: on an isolated software fixture, an agent session in propose mode reaches the app through its harness endpoint, exactly as `eak --propose` would, and proposes four steps (two parts, a VIN label on a pin of the first part, a design-rule change). The project does not move: the schematic stays empty. Tools > Review agent proposals... shows EAK's review: six changes grouped by object (Part 4, Net 1, Rule 1) and ERC and DRC on a copy. Unchecking the first part's row also unchecks the label that names it (Applying 2 of 4 steps); EAK reviews that selection again, Export report saves its review as evidence, and Apply sends the two steps as one Batch: one part on the sheet, and one Edit > Undo takes it all back. A second proposal is then discarded (asked to confirm first), after which it cannot be applied and nothing changed. Stale and agent-applied refusals are covered by crates/eak-harness/tests/proposal.rs and src-tauri/tests/proposal.rs; the rows and selection rules by src/shell/proposalReview.test.tsx.
